question: How should the D-loop vs 12S/MiFish molecular assay be recorded -- as a column on obs, or as its own row?
context: Each detection comes from one of two assays (D-loop or 12S/MiFish, from dnaderiveddata.target_gene).
answer: SUPERSEDED 2026-10-01 (Ben Best, PR #118 review decision B4): the assay is encoded in the measurement_type (edna_reads_dloop / edna_reads_12s), one obs row per filter x taxon x assay, and no obs_attribute row is emitted -- an obs_attribute row has no key back to its obs row, so a filter detecting one taxon by both assays could not say which read count was which.
